External tileset and image references survive source rename/move and complete package closure
Missing dependency repair updates stable references and failed replacement retains source identity
Unsupported/malformed/oversized map inputs fail before allocating a partial resource
Collision rectangle/polygon and variable frame durations survive normal runtime serialization
Simple XML map/tileset paths bind and compressed or complex XML is rejected explicitly
Runtime draw commands retain cell arrays, use explicit clock, refresh decoded image readiness and detach editor documents
Atlas publication advances the actual content revision and invalidates normalized frame caches
Imported map refuses destructive definition saves; editable copy survives source reimport, reload and export closure
Repeated observation of frozen valid and malformed tilemaps never changes component or cell identities
XML explicit zero offsets, hidden layers and zero parallax retain numeric and boolean meaning
Project replacement immediately releases parsed tileset cache ownership
